rationale: C03 is an exceptionally close drafting template: it concerns extension of enlistments in the armed forces and ends with the same operative implementation sentence as the child, with only the responsible official changed from the Secretary of Defense to the Secretary of the Treasury for the Coast Guard. C18 is substantively relevant because it uses the same Defense/Treasury division for armed forces and Coast Guard administration, but it does not match the child's concise implementation clause as directly. C22 shares similar implementation wording but concerns an unrelated subject and its language is less exact.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby directed to take such steps as he may deem necessary to carry out the provisions of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense is hereby directed to take such steps as he may deem necessary to carry out the provisions of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The entire operative sentence is reproduced nearly verbatim, substituting the official responsible for the Coast Guard for the official responsible for the other armed forces.
